Made by D. C. Imamura. Forwarded by [签名] O.I.

Rear Admiral Idemitsu, aide-de-camp to His Majesty the
Emperor of Japan, who returned to Shanghai on May 10, 1933,
after conveying an Imperial message to naval officers and men
stationed along the Yangtsze, left for North China by the s.s.
"Choshun Maru" which sailed from the D.K.K. Whangpoo Wharf at
9.20 a.m. May 12, 1933.
The Admiral arrived at the wharf at 8.50 a.m., an escort
being provided by a party of officers from the Reserve Unit in
a motor-cycle combination in conjunction with the Naval Landing
Party and the Gendarmerie.
No untoward incident occurred. From the Special Branch
D. C. Imamura attended.

Date April 7, 1933.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Rear Admiral Idemitsu, Aide-de-Camp to His Majesty the Emperor of Japan.

Made by D. C. Imamura. Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt.

Rear Admiral Idemitsu, Aide-de-Camp to His Majesty the Emperor of Japan, will arrive in Shanghai by the S.S. "Nagasaki Maru", which is due here at about 2.30 p.m. April 8, 1933.

The object of his visit is to convey messages from Their Majesties the Emperor and Empress to the members of the Japanese Navy along the Yangtse and in Shanghai and to hand them Imperial gifts.

According to Captain Sato, Japanese Naval Attache, the programme of the Admiral's movements during his sojourn here will be as follows:-

April 8: Arrival at the Hoyo Hotel, 10 Haining Rd.

April 10: 9 a.m. visit to the "Idzumo", flagship of Admiral Yonai, to convey the Emperor's message. Later visit to the "Tenryu" and the 27th Flotilla.

During the afternoon, he will call at the Headquarters of the Japanese Naval Landing Party, the Naval Hospital and the detachment stationed in the Western District.

April 11: During the morning, visits will be paid to the detachment stationed in the Eastern District and the Navy Club on Baikal Road.

In the afternoon, the Japanese Cemetery will be visited and an inspection of the former war zones in Chapei will be made.

April 12: Leave Shanghai for the Upper Yangtse.

A detachment of about 30 marines will be detailed for guard duty at the Wayside Wharf 30 minutes before the arrival of the vessel and an escort of six men under an officer will be provided by the Japanese Navy to accompany the Admiral in all his movements.

日本天皇侍从武官井出勇海军少将将乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船抵达上海，该轮预计于1933年4月8日下午2时30分左右抵沪。

他此次访问的目的是向长江沿线及上海的日本海军人员传达天皇和皇后的旨意，并赠送御赐礼物。

据日本海军武官佐藤上校称，少将在沪期间的行程安排如下：

4月8日：抵达海宁路10号宝裕馆旅馆。

4月10日：上午9时拜访米内大将的旗舰“出云”号，传达天皇旨意。随后拜访“天龙”号及第27舰队。

下午，他将造访日本海军陆战队总部、海军医院以及驻扎在西区的分队。

4月11日：上午，将拜访驻扎在东区的分队以及贝加尔路的海军俱乐部。

下午，将参观日本公墓，并视察闸北的前战区。

4月12日：离开上海前往长江上游。

在船只抵达前30分钟，将派遣约30名海军陆战队员在杨树浦码头执行警卫任务，日本海军将派出一名军官率领六人组成的护卫队，陪同少将进行所有活动。
